nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest for the @org/api NestJS application, declaring NestJS runtime dependencies and Nx build/serve/prune targets that drive webpack compilation and packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds Nx project targets directly under the 'nx' key, using executors like @nx/js:node and @nx/js:prune-lockfile to manage the build pipeline.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for building the API application sources, extending the base tsconfig and scoping include/exclude to app code while referencing project dependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript solution config for the API app, extending the workspace base config and wiring project references to the app and spec build configs.
